_purpose: Confirmed control-level changes when a new framework version is loaded. Populated by oscal_diff.py --write-changelog (human_confirmed=false) and by humans for non-OSCAL frameworks.
_usage: human_confirmed=false entries are machine-generated diffs. Set human_confirmed=true after verifying on the primary source. announcement_ref links to an entry_id in announcements_feed.json.

entries.summary: Added 7 controls missing from original Rev 5 XLSX: IA-13, SA-24, SI-2(7), PM-30(1), PM-32, PT-2(1), SR-3(2). Also corrected minor editorial issues in control text and parameter values. OSCAL content updated to reflect full catalog.
entries.confirmation_source: usnistgov/oscal-content GitHub CHANGELOG + NIST CSRC errata page

entries.summary: Added crosswalk columns for CMMC 2.0 (110 controls), EU DORA (72 articles), ISO/IEC 29151:2017 (Privacy for PII), and CMS ARS v5.1 (CMS-tailored NIST 800-53 baseline). Total framework columns in the hub increased from 60 to 64. Existing control IDs (01-09 series) unchanged.
entries.confirmation_source: HITRUST Alliance release notes + updated cross-reference workbook header inspection

entries.summary: Structural refinements to 197 cloud control domains. Updated implementation guidance and mapping metadata. Control IDs (CCM-001 through CCM-197 series) preserved. New GitHub YAML/CSV/XLSX format replaces prior XLSX-only distribution. Added explicit versioning to SRM (Security Resource Management) domain.
entries.notes: v4.0.12 was not an official CSA release number — it was a vendor-applied patch label on the v4 XLSX. v4.1 is the first officially numbered minor release.
entries.confirmation_source: CSA CCM GitHub releases page + cloudsecurityalliance/cloud-controls-matrix tag v4.1

entries.summary: Major revision: restructured from 14 to 15 chapters. Added dedicated chapters for OAuth 2.0/OIDC (V11), WebRTC (V12), and Cryptography (renumbered V7). Removed deprecated v4 controls for basic auth and MD5/SHA-1. All requirement IDs renumbered (V1.x through V15.x). Added AI/LLM-specific requirements in V14. Approximately 80 new requirements; 45 removed; 120 materially modified.
entries.notes: Breaking change: v4.0.3 and v5.0.0 requirement IDs do NOT map 1:1. Crosswalk from OWASP GitHub in release notes. feed_registry entry updated from v4.0.3 → v5.0.0.
entries.confirmation_source: OWASP/ASVS GitHub releases tag v5.0.0 + release notes CHANGELOG.md

entries.summary: FedRAMP baseline controls updated from NIST SP 800-53 Rev 4 to Rev 5. LOW baseline: 125 → 156 controls. MODERATE baseline: 325 → 323 controls (minor net reduction despite additions). HIGH baseline: 421 → 421 controls (restructured). All baselines now published exclusively in OSCAL JSON/XML format via GSA/fedramp-automation GitHub. Legacy Word/Excel templates retired. FedRAMP-specific parameter constraints updated for all 3 baselines.
entries.notes: Rev 5 adoption required by all new FedRAMP authorizations. Existing Rev 4 ATOs had 2-year transition window ending 2025. FedRAMP 20x pilot (2024+) builds on Rev 5 baseline.
entries.confirmation_source: GSA/fedramp-automation GitHub release notes + FedRAMP PMO transition memo (Mar 2023)

entries.summary: Release 5.2.0 (responding to EO 14306): new and updated controls for the security and reliability of software updates and patches — resiliency by design, developer testing, update deployment/management, software integrity and validation; revised discussion text on several existing controls. OSCAL content bundles 800-53A r5.2.0 assessment procedures (content last modified 2026-05-11). Control-level add/modify lists not enumerated here — derive with oscal_diff.py against a 5.1.1 snapshot before confirming.

Three interim releases since v11.5.0: v11.6.0 (2025-08-22, HAA 2025-003), v11.7.0 (2025-12-18, HAA 2025-005), v11.8.0 (2026-05-08). All new e1/i1 assessment objects must use v11.8.0 since 2026-05-07 (HAA 2025-006). The repo's licensed cross-reference artifact remains v11.4.0; hub mappings stay pinned there until a newer cross-reference is provided.

CCM v4.1: 207 controls across 17 domains; CAIQ v4.1 updated to 283 questions; Implementation and Auditing Guidelines, CCM-Lite and CAIQ-Lite refreshed. Repo raw CCM file remains v4.0.x pending artifact refresh.

Third edition. Annex A completely restructured to align with ISO/IEC 27002:2022: 114 controls in 14 clauses (A.5-A.18) become 93 controls in 4 themes (5 Organizational, 6 People, 7 Physical, 8 Technological). 11 new controls (5.7 threat intelligence, 5.23 cloud services, 5.30 ICT readiness for business continuity, 7.4 physical security monitoring, 8.9 configuration management, 8.10 information deletion, 8.11 data masking, 8.12 data leakage prevention, 8.16 monitoring activities, 8.23 web filtering, 8.28 secure coding); no 2013 controls dropped outright — the rest merged or renumbered. ISMS management clauses 4-10 structurally unchanged (minor 6.3 addition, 9.2/9.3 subdivided). Amd 1:2024 adds climate-change consideration text (no control changes). Transition period ended 2025-10-31 — 2013 certificates no longer valid.

Third edition, published before 27001:2022 and defining the restructure 27001 Annex A adopted: 93 controls in 4 themes with attribute tagging (control type, InfoSec properties, cybersecurity concepts, operational capabilities, security domains). Annex B of 27002:2022 carries the official 2013<->2022 correspondence tables — the authoritative source for any future legacy-id bridge (NOT reproduced in this repo; add the artifact before loading legacy 2013-cited report data).

800-172r3 + 800-172Ar3: enhanced requirements renumbered/aligned to 171r3 (17 families, 115 requirements); expanded segmentation, resilience, supply-chain coverage; mappings to 800-160 protection strategies. OSCAL + CPRT datasets published. CMMC Level 3 still cites the 2021 edition — dual pin retained; derive control-level deltas with oscal_diff before confirming. Phase 19: CPRT 172r3 dataset pinned (manifest id cprt-sp800-172r3) incl. NIST's 172r3->800-53 r5.2.0 mapping (107 edges) — 'NIST SP 800-172 r3' is a spine framework; publication PDFs pinned under reference-crosswalks/.

v17 (Apr 2025), v18 (Oct 2025: Detections replaced by Detection Strategies + Analytics), v19 (Apr 2026: Defense Evasion split into Stealth + Defense Impairment; ICS sub-techniques; Mobile detection strategies). Enterprise STIX v19.1 ingested.
Two new categories (Software Supply Chain Failures; Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions); SSRF absorbed into Broken Access Control; 3 renames, 4 re-rankings; 248 CWEs mapped.
Digital identity guidelines Rev 4 finalized. Repo's generated nist-800-63b-requirements.json still derives from 63B r3 — regeneration from 63B-4 is an open follow-up.

67 -> 63 requirements (removals/consolidations + 2 net-new in Sections J/K); AI supplier types split into Publishers and Deployers with independent assurance for both; Sensitive Personal Data + PHI added to Highly Confidential; explicit Red Status sanctions.

Major restructuring: requirements renumbered to 03.xx.yy, ODPs introduced, families realigned to 800-53r5. NIST's own r2->r3 analysis workbook is pinned on disk (manifest id sp800-171-r2-to-r3-analysis) as the authoritative delta artifact, plus the r3 CUI overlay and the CPRT r3 dataset carrying NIST's 171r3->800-53r5 mapping (157 edges). CMMC 2.0 still legally targets r2 (DoD class deviation May 2024) — the repo keeps both: 'NIST SP 800-171 r2' (CMMC basis) and 'NIST SP 800-171 r3' (spine framework since Phase 19). Seeds the CMMC->r3 transition the runbook tracks.
entries.notes: Delta detail lives in the pinned NIST analysis workbook — not enumerated here to avoid transcription drift.

entries.summary: STIG application layer added (schema 3.8): 383 benchmarks / 19,667 rules / 539 distinct CCIs distilled from the DISA SRG-STIG Library for CCI application evidence. One changelog entry per quarterly library version; per-title deltas surface in the announcements feed.

Full CCI dictionary loaded (schema 3.9): all 5,137 CCIs with definitions + status (587 previously dropped now retained); legacy Rev-3-only CCIs recovered to base r5 controls; cci_mapping_corroboration cross-witnesses CCI↔800-53 across DISA + acasehs + trackr + STIG usage.

Re-pinned to Release 5.2.0 to match the committed 5.2.0 OSCAL supplement already in the build (7 added controls IA-13/IA-13(1)-(3)/SA-15(13)/SA-24/SI-2(7) present in the DB); label/metadata update, no data reload.
